title: Trap Negation L5-2
source: Port-authored setup from Tools/puzzles/generate_puzzles.py template 'trap_negation', level 5, variant 2. The line uses engine-supported cards but is not a GBA fixed-board reconstruction.
notes: Seven Tools of the Bandit is already Set; the engine auto-negates Mirror Force when the lethal direct attack is declared.

canon_reference.setup_status: canon setup unavailable; this file uses a port-authored template
solution_steps: Activate Back to Square One and, by discarding Summoned Skull, return the Summoned Skull on your opponents side of the field to his deck.
Activate Conscription to get this Summoned Skull back.
Activate Polymerization to Fuse Summoned Skull on the field and Red-Eyes B. Dragon in your hand and form B. Skull Dragon.
Activate Dragon's Mirror and get out another B. Skull Dragon by removing from play the Fusion Materials in your graveyard.
